words.input: generator client { provider = "prisma-client" output = "../src/generated/prisma" } datasource db { provider = "postgresql" } model User { id Int @id @default(autoincrement()) email String @unique name String? age Int? active Boolean @default(true) createdAt DateTime @default(now()) tags String[] profile Json? posts Post[] } model Post { id Int @id @default(autoincrement()) title String published Boolean @default(false) authorId Int author User @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id]) }
words.annotation: サンプルschema.prisma：クエリ例に使うモデル（PostgreSQL向け。Client生成・マイグレーションが必要。コード例は独立した断片）

words.input: import "dotenv/config"; import { defineConfig, env } from "prisma/config"; export default defineConfig({ schema: "prisma/schema.prisma", migrations: { path: "prisma/migrations" }, datasource: { url: env("DATABASE_URL") } });
words.annotation: prisma.config.ts：CLIの接続設定（Prisma 7の例。dotenv等の依存とDATABASE_URLが必要）

words.input: import "dotenv/config"; import { PrismaClient } from "./generated/prisma/client"; import { PrismaPg } from "@prisma/adapter-pg"; const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL; if (!connectionString) throw new Error("DATABASE_URL is required"); const adapter = new PrismaPg({ connectionString }); const prisma = new PrismaClient({ adapter });
words.annotation: PrismaClient / adapter：PostgreSQLに接続するClient（src/db.tsを想定。生成先・拡張子等は環境に合わせる。Prisma 7の通常の直接接続向け）

words.input: generator client { provider = "prisma-client" output = "../src/generated/prisma" }
words.annotation: generator：Client生成方法を指定（Prisma 7ではoutput指定が必要。schema.prismaに記述）

words.display: const user = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: 1 } });
words.input: const user = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: 1 } });
words.annotation: findUniqueOrThrow：なければ例外

words.display: const user = await prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { active: true }, orderBy: { id: 'asc' } });
words.input: const user = await prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { active: true }, orderBy: { id: 'asc' } });
words.annotation: findFirst：条件に合う先頭の1件（なければnull。順序が必要ならorderBy）

words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { active: true, OR: [{ age: { gte: 20 } }, { age: null }] } });
words.annotation: AND / OR / NOT：条件の組合せ

words.display: await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { id: { in: [1, 2, 3] } } });
words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { id: { in: [1, 2, 3] } } });
words.annotation: in / notIn：候補で絞る（NULLの扱いに注意）

words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { email: { contains: 'example.com', mode: 'insensitive' } } });
words.annotation: contains / mode：文字列部分一致（modeはPostgreSQL向け。DBによって対応が異なる）

words.display: await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: 1 }, include: { posts: true } });
words.input: await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: 1 }, include: { posts: true } });
words.annotation: include：関連データを取得（関連件数・クエリ負荷に注意）

words.display: await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { posts: { some: { published: true } } } });
words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { posts: { some: { published: true } } } });
words.annotation: relation some：関連行の存在条件（none・every等もある。everyは関連0件でも真）

words.display: await prisma.user.findMany({ orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }] });
words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }] });
words.annotation: orderBy：並べ替え

words.display: await prisma.user.findMany({ orderBy: { id: 'asc' }, skip: 20, take: 10 });
words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ orderBy: { id: 'asc' }, skip: 20, take: 10 });
words.annotation: skip / take：件数とオフセット（大きいskipの負荷に注意）

words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ cursor: { id: 100 }, skip: 1, take: 10, orderBy: { id: 'asc' } });
words.annotation: cursor：カーソルページング（一意なカーソル等と順序を整合させる）

words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ distinct: ['name'], select: { name: true } });
words.annotation: distinct：重複を除いた結果（DB側のSELECT DISTINCTと同じ実装とは限らない）

words.display: await prisma.user.aggregate({ _avg: { age: true }, _max: { age: true } });
words.input: await prisma.user.aggregate({ _avg: { age: true }, _max: { age: true } });
words.annotation: aggregate：集計（対象なし・NULLでは集計値がnullの場合）

words.display: await prisma.post.groupBy({ by: ['authorId'], _count: { _all: true } });
words.input: await prisma.post.groupBy({ by: ['authorId'], _count: { _all: true } });
words.annotation: groupBy：グループ集計

words.input: await prisma.user.create({ data: { email: 'pomo@example.com', name: 'Pomo', tags: [] } });
words.annotation: create：1件追加（一意制約競合で失敗し得る）

words.input: await prisma.user.createMany({ data: [{ email: 'a@example.com', tags: [] }, { email: 'b@example.com', tags: [] }], skipDuplicates: true });
words.annotation: createMany：複数件追加（skipDuplicatesは対応DBに依存。例はPostgreSQL）

words.display: await prisma.user.createManyAndReturn({ data: [{ email: 'c@example.com', tags: [] }] });
words.input: await prisma.user.createManyAndReturn({ data: [{ email: 'c@example.com', tags: [] }] });
words.annotation: createManyAndReturn：複数追加して行を返す（対応DB・バージョンに依存。このCSVはPrisma 7/PostgreSQL）

words.display: await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: 1 }, data: { name: 'New' } });
words.input: await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: 1 }, data: { name: 'New' } });
words.annotation: update：一意条件で更新（対象なしは例外）

words.display: await prisma.user.updateMany({ where: { active: false }, data: { name: null } });
words.input: await prisma.user.updateMany({ where: { active: false }, data: { name: null } });
words.annotation: updateMany：一致する複数行を更新（whereを省略すると全件）

words.display: await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: 1 }, data: { age: { increment: 1 } } });
words.input: await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: 1 }, data: { age: { increment: 1 } } });
words.annotation: increment：数値を原子的に加算（NULLのageは加算されない）

words.input: await prisma.user.upsert({ where: { email: 'pomo@example.com' }, update: { name: 'New' }, create: { email: 'pomo@example.com', tags: [] } });
words.annotation: upsert：存在すれば更新・なければ追加（DBネイティブupsertになる条件等を確認）

words.input: await prisma.user.create({ data: { email: 'nested@example.com', tags: [], posts: { create: { title: 'Hello' } } } });
words.annotation: nested create：関連もまとめて作成（一連のネスト書き込みは原子的）

words.input: await prisma.post.create({ data: { title: 'Hello', author: { connect: { id: 1 } } } });
words.annotation: connect：既存行と関連付け（関連先が必要）

words.display:
await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { tags: { has: 'sql' } } });
await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: 1 }, data: { tags: { push: 'go' } } });
words.input: await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { tags: { has: 'sql' } } }); await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: 1 }, data: { tags: { push: 'go' } } });
words.annotation: has / push：配列の検索・追記（スカラーリスト対応DB向け）

words.display: await prisma.$transaction([prisma.user.update({ where: { id: 1 }, data: { active: true } }), prisma.post.updateMany({ where: { authorId: 1 }, data: { published: true } })]);
words.input: await prisma.$transaction([prisma.user.update({ where: { id: 1 }, data: { active: true } }), prisma.post.updateMany({ where: { authorId: 1 }, data: { published: true } })]);
words.annotation: $transaction([])：クエリをまとめて確定（失敗時はDB書き込みをロールバック。既にawaitした結果は渡さない）

words.input: await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => { const user = await tx.user.create({ data: { email: 'tx@example.com', tags: [] } }); await tx.post.create({ data: { title: 'Hello', authorId: user.id } }); });
words.annotation: $transaction(callback)：処理を含むトランザクション（内部はtxを使う。外部通信等で長時間保持しない）

words.display:
const id = 1;
const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw `SELECT id, email FROM "User" WHERE id = ${id}`;
words.input: const id = 1; const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT id, email FROM "User" WHERE id = ${id}`;
words.annotation: $queryRaw：パラメーター付きSQL取得（タグ付きテンプレートを使用。識別子の動的置換には使えない）

words.display:
const id = 1;
await prisma.$executeRaw `UPDATE "User" SET active = false WHERE id = ${id}`;
words.input: const id = 1; await prisma.$executeRaw`UPDATE "User" SET active = false WHERE id = ${id}`;
words.annotation: $executeRaw：パラメーター付きSQL更新（実データを変更。文字列連結やUnsafe APIへ未検証入力を渡さない）

words.input: import { Prisma } from './generated/prisma/client'; try { await prisma.user.create({ data: { email: 'pomo@example.com', tags: [] } }); } catch (e) { if (e instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && e.code === 'P2002') { console.log('一意制約違反'); } else { throw e; } }
words.annotation: PrismaClientKnownRequestError：既知のDB操作エラーを判定（importパスはsrc内の例。再試行・ユーザー表示は用途に合わせる）
